python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data
start_value = 1459.5  # FY 1947
end_value = 2106.4    # FY 1950
years = 3  # From 1947 to 1950 is 3 years

# CAGR formula: (End/Start)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (end_value / start_value) ** (1/years) - 1

# Convert to percentage
cagr_percent = cagr * 100

print(f"Start value (1947): ${start_value} million")
print(f"End value (1950): ${end_value} million")
print(f"Number of years: {years}")
print(f"CAGR: {cagr} (as decimal)")
print(f"CAGR: {cagr_percent}%")
print(f"CAGR rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(cagr_percent, 3)}%")
EOF
